FILED VIA PATENT CENTER
Application No.: 18/598,305
This is an Amendment After Allowance under 37 C.F.R. § 1.312 submitted after the Notice of Allowance dated February 20, 2025, but before payment of the Issue Fee.
Applicant submits this 37 C.F.R. § 1.312 amendment to correct matters of form, in
particular, to correct minor grammatical errors in claims 7, 20, and 24. Applicant respectfully requests that the amendments be entered.

Applicant acknowledges the Examiner's statements of reasons for allowance of the above-referenced patent application and agrees that the claimed subject matter is patentably distinct over the references cited. However, Applicant not taking a position regarding the reasons for allowance presented by the Examiner other than the positions Applicant may have previously taken during prosecution. Therefore, the Examiner's reasons for allowance should not be attributed to Applicant as an indication of the basis for Applicant's belief that the claims are patentably distinct. Furthermore, it is respectfully asserted that there may be additional reasons for patentability of the claimed subject matter not explicitly stated in this record and Applicant does not waive its rights to such arguments by not further addressing such reasons herein.
